jobs.description: TL;DR You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. jobs.description: About the role This is a permanent, part-time role, working two days a week. Unity is a scaling business with strong reward foundations already in place. We now need a senior reward specialist to strengthen them, fill the gaps and shape them into a framework that grows with the firm. We want reward that reflects how Unity actually works: Partner-led client teams, Functional Leader-led enablement teams, and a culture built on trust, direct feedback and progress over process. You’ll refine it each cycle and make sure the framework is well documented and easy for others to work with. It suits someone who gets energy from building and improving, and who knows that reward only proves itself once it’s live. You’ll be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making judgement calls. jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. jobs.description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt? Dit is jouw uitdaging Verhuisketens geven inzicht in de doorstroom op de woningmarkt en zijn daardoor actueel en relevant. Het CBS heeft een methode ontwikkeld om deze ketens in beeld te brengen. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping. Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt? jobs.description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work.
